records.prompt: Create a production 2D painted sprite atlas for ProjectMystery's police-car ending, based strictly on the attached approved character reference sheets. Context: contemporary Chinese, refined semi-realistic hand-painted game, restrained comic contours, matte cloth, stable anatomy; adults age 26–28, do not redesign faces, age, hairstyle or costumes. Four equal vertical cells in ONE horizontal row, precisely separated by generous empty transparent gutters. Each cell contains one complete seated adult seen straight from the FRONT, facing the front of the car towards the viewer, sitting on an IMPLIED rear bench with pelvis properly supported, thighs forward, knees naturally bent, relaxed forearms and hands resting naturally on their own thighs, full lower legs and shoes visible. All share the same seat/hip and foot baselines and compatible proportions. No bench, car, shadow plate, floor, text, labels, captions or other props; fully transparent background. Cell1: XiaoPeng from the dark jacket default reference, short dark hair, charcoal short jacket over gray shirt, gray-brown trousers and dark shoes. Cell2: exact same XiaoPeng face and body, from gray long-sleeve shirt and dark denim overalls approved reference. Cell3: exact same XiaoPeng face and body in the navy-and-cream school tracksuit visible in the adult school uniform reference; restrained white stripe, navy pants and sneakers. Cell4: QiuTian / guide from green LONG coat reference, dark medium hair, olive long coat open over off-white inner shirt, dark gray trousers and worn dark shoes; coat naturally folds around bent hips, hands on thighs. Subtle 10 degree inward gaze is okay but torsos must face forward and cannot be side profiles, rear views or kneeling. The seated anatomy is more important than decorative folds. No extra arms or fingers, no floating shoes, no cropped heads or feet, no large empty upper margin. Full-resolution consistent atlas, robust visible silhouette at actual in-game scale.

为ProjectMystery的警车上车分页漫画制作正式手绘三格横向漫画，横向宽画布，三格宽度完全相等，用细黑色格线隔开。依据参考警车，它是车头朝右的灰白色中国警用轿车，外观朴素哑光，不能换成SUV。依据人物参考，第一格张辰是人物群参考最右侧年轻警察，蓝色短袖制服、深蓝长裤；第二格是绿长外套白内衫的引路人邱天；第三格是短黑发、黑色短外套灰内衫棕灰长裤的肖鹏。要极清楚地看到“开门并进入车内”，不能站在车旁：每格都显示完整车门及座椅，车头都朝右。第一格前驾驶座门打开，张辰已经弯腰钻入车内，头与上身在驾驶舱，近侧腿仍在地面、另腿已跨入门槛，手扶门框。第二格后排门打开，邱天侧身低头把上身探入后排车舱，绿大衣自然垂落，腿正在跨过门槛，一手扶门框。第三格仍然是同一后排门，肖鹏半坐入后排座椅，身子与头在车舱内，近侧腿正从地面抬进门槛，前面的引路人只能见到模糊绿衣背影，不能多个人站门外。必须人物与车门相互真实遮挡、肢体完整合理、人物尺寸与轿车比例一致，手指不增生，不同时出现重复的人或重复的胳膊。三个清晰而不同的入车过程，形成张辰→引路人→肖鹏的次序。背景是简洁当代中国雨夜住宅街道，统一暖路灯、蓝灰雨夜，少地面不空旷。精细偏写实手绘漫画哑光风，不用光滑CG、不用浓重卡通黑边。无对白、标题、字母、乱码、标识或UI，警灯可以有红蓝色块但车身不要文字。三格均可独立裁切用于游戏逐格推进。

只编辑第一张参考中的第三格（最右边），将正在坐入警车后排的肖鹏服装改成灰色长袖衬衫和深蓝色牛仔背带长裤，按第二张参考的服装，保留完整身形和入车姿势。必须保持第三格的同一个人、同一个脸型、发型、年龄、身体比例、腿部弯曲、鞋跨入门槛的姿势以及警车车门的遮挡关系。第一格警察和第二格引路人，车、门、光照、背景、雨水、细节、格线、整个画布尺寸和构图都完全保持原样。不要添加文字或其他人，不要改变入车状态为站立。维持精细手绘偏写实漫画哑光风。

只编辑第一张参考中的第三格（最右边），将正在坐入警车后排的肖鹏服装改成深蓝与米白相间的校服运动外套、深蓝长裤、朴素运动鞋，按第二张参考的成年校服，保留完整身形和入车姿势。必须保持第三格的同一个人、同一个脸型、发型、年龄、身体比例、腿部弯曲、鞋跨入门槛的姿势以及警车车门的遮挡关系。第一格警察和第二格引路人，车、门、光照、背景、雨水、细节、格线、整个画布尺寸和构图都完全保持原样。不要添加文字或其他人，不要改变入车状态为站立。维持精细手绘偏写实漫画哑光风。

制作《ProjectMystery》正式二维手绘角色的头部切片，不是全身图，不是漫画。参考附图最右侧穿蓝白校服的青年男性向焱，必须保持他的短黑发、眉眼、脸型和年龄；变身后仅眼睛深暗红、神情阴冷克制，皮肤稍苍白，不增加怪物部件。画面中仅有两个独立完整的头和少量自然脖颈，均为真正侧面。左边一格：脸朝屏幕右方，鼻尖指向右边；右边一格：脸朝屏幕左方，鼻尖指向左边。两颗头相互背对而非相同朝向。需要完整头发、耳朵、脸、下颌、脖颈下端，不能裁断头发，不画衣服或肩膀。精细偏写实的当代中国手绘漫画风、哑光自然笔触、细轮廓线，匹配参考人物。不写字，不画格线，不画雾、光晕、地面或阴影。完全透明的背景，两个切片之间留足透明间隙，两个头比例一致，各占同尺寸的正方形格。这是供现有已通过的校服骨骼动作绑定使用的独立角色身份头部，不改变动作骨骼。

Production transparent 2D sprite atlas for the existing antagonist XiangYan (向焱) in ProjectMystery. Use the rightmost male from attached school support sheet ONLY as the identity reference: young Chinese male, short dark hair, strong brow, navy and cream school tracksuit, navy pants with restrained white side stripe, sneakers. Existing approved contemporary refined semi-realistic hand-painted comic art, matte cloth, crisp readable anatomy, no shiny CG, no redesign of identity or clothes. Horror transformation has made him tense and sinister: muted small red eyes, slightly charcoal-darkened SAME uniform, no monster anatomy, no huge shoulders. One character per cell, absolutely complete body and shoes, no text, labels, panels, floor, shadows, flames or other people. Full transparent background. EXACTLY EIGHT cells in a regular FOUR columns by TWO rows grid, generous empty gutters. All eight figures same height and scale with consistent proportions and head size, feet baseline near bottom of their cell, no cropping. Each image is a different consecutive key pose of ONE complete running cycle. Torsos lean subtly forward 10 degrees in running direction; legs genuinely pass and flex, knee goes forward during swing, support foot planted at contact, shoes coherently angled with ankle. Arms alternate opposite legs: upper arms swing from behind torso to forward, elbows flex about 75-100 degrees, forearms collected toward chest, relaxed partially closed hands, not straight hands pointing forward. No duplicated legs, no twisted wrist, no floating disconnected joints. Positions 1-8: left-leg forward heel contact, left support compressed / right foot lift, right leg passing under body, right leg forward flight; right-leg forward contact, right support compressed / left foot lift, left leg passing, left forward flight. Contact foot flat/rocking naturally rather than pointed vertically. No whole-body squashing, no changing body angle unrelated to running. ALL EIGHT FIGURES RUN AND FACE SCREEN RIGHT, true RIGHT SIDE profile or very slight three-quarter side that still clearly faces right. Near and far limbs remain anatomically consistent across all cells; track sequential movement, not eight identical poses.

Production horror comic page for a contemporary Chinese hand-painted 2D mystery game. Use the RIGHTMOST teenage boy in the reference only as the exact identity: short dark hair, strong eyebrows, cream/navy zip-up school tracksuit, navy trousers white stripe. Four wide cinematic panels arranged in a precise 2 by 2 grid with thin black gutters, no typography, no speech bubbles, no lettering, no UI. Panel 1 top-left: at a dim school office doorway the same boy stands normally, suspicious restrained expression. Panel 2 top-right: close upper body, face tenses and his shoulders hunch naturally, black ink-like wisps begin coming from the edges of his clothing. Panel 3 bottom-left: same face transforming into an ominous shadow, eyes a small muted red glow, smoky black flames flow from head and back, credible continuous neck and shoulder anatomy. Panel 4 bottom-right: full body in a credible sprint profile toward the RIGHT with forward lean, bent opposing arms, one leg reaching and the other lifting behind, black flames trailing; recognizably the same school tracksuit, full shoes visible. The transformation must be a smooth and intelligible progression, dark and frightening without gore. Controlled matte colour planes, refined realistic proportions, warm grey/sage school wall fragments, blue-black atmosphere, clean brush edges. No other characters and no overlapping portraits outside panels. Keep 15 percent quiet darker space within each panel for live game captions. Crisp at highest landscape resolution.

Edit the supplied approved hospital illustration into a single very wide side-view 2D game background for ProjectMystery's final ward walking scene. Preserve its refined semi-realistic hand-painted Chinese contemporary hospital style, muted pale warm grey plaster, sage-green lower wall, muted teal medical fittings, the exact coherent metal hospital-bed design, white covered bedding and opaque teal-green privacy curtain. This is a new wider establishing composition rather than magnifying the bed. Ultra-wide panorama approximately 3:1, at least 2400 pixels wide if possible. Left 40 percent is an uninterrupted quiet pale wall with a modest frosted window and one small front-facing bedside cabinet, no objects at human height blocking a walking actor. The compact covered hospital bed occupies middle-right about x 47%-69%, with mattress at a realistic waist/below-waist height and caster wheels firmly contacting one continuous horizontal wall-floor line at y 88%. The bed must be correctly scaled for a 1.8-m tall person, not huge. Closed opaque hanging curtain occupies x 69%-80%, fully obscures the patient's head and pillow and any identifying features; no patient face, no other people, no text, labels, HUD, characters or placeholder shapes. Continue uninterrupted same wall to the edges without seams, but keep recognizable details modest. Floor is only the bottom 12% shallow strip, flat muted seamless matte grey, NO long perspective grout or vertical board textures, NO empty deep floor foreground. Clear crisp source detail, restrained painted texture, consistent straight-on viewpoint, no tilted furniture or inconsistent vanishing points. One continuous finished painting, no panels or collage edges.
